app.name: Harvey WhatsApp
app.short_description: Take over a WhatsApp chat from Harvey, or give it back.
app.long_description: Shows whether Harvey (the Fixfy WhatsApp assistant) is handling the chat on this ticket. Take over moves the chat to the team and unlocks the ticket; Give back to Harvey hands it back.
app.installation_instructions: Paste the token saved as `HARVEY_WA_ZENDESK_APP_TOKEN` in Vercel (master-os).

api_token.label: Fixfy OS token
api_token.helpText: The value of `HARVEY_WA_ZENDESK_APP_TOKEN` in Vercel. Stored securely by Zendesk, never shown to agents.
